reponse: To enable the new dashboards locally, run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` (the API must be running), then hard-reload the page. You can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags`. The old method using FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash in .env.local no longer works [2][3].
